original.target_description: Study 5 composite life-history stereotypes: Black versus White targets from desperate ecologies (ecology override test). Multiple contrasts fit the broad locator; exact selected contrast not specified.

n.sample_role: participants in desperate-ecology Black-versus-White contrast; test-specific n not established
n.exclusions: Study-wide sample 302 spans eight conditions and is not analytic n for this contrast.

p.quote: Indeed, stereotypes of white and black individuals from desperate ecologies did not differ ( P = 0.59), nor did stereotypes of white and black individuals from hopeful ecologies ( P = 0.69).

replication.target_description: participants; high-wealth targets, hopeful versus desperate ecologies; authors’ post-replication report focal test.

n.sample_role: participants; high-wealth targets, hopeful versus desperate ecologies; 112 total is sum of the two explicitly printed groups
n.exclusions: Preregistered eligibility, completion and attention checks; see report Sample and protocol deviations.
n.quote: In the replication experiment, for high-wealth individuals from desperate ecologies, the average composite score of fast life history strategies was 3.676 (sd = 1.117; n = 56), while for high-wealth individuals from hopeful ecologies, the average composite score of fast life history strategies was 3.070 (sd = 0.814; n = 56).

es.quote: The standardized effect size (Cohen’s d) is d = 0.621 (95% CI [0.246, 0.995]).

p.quote: The difference of 0.607 (se = 0.185) was tested using an independent samples t-test with equal variances (t(110) = 3.286, p = 0.001).

reported_success.quote: Discussion: Given the criteria and procedure outlined above, the hypothesis of interest has been replicated at a significance level of p < 0.05.

notes: Original and replication evaluated separately. Replication statistics are as printed in the primary authors’ post-replication report. Replication targets original Study 3 high-wealth ecology comparison, whereas assigned original locator specifies Study 5 (race × ecology). Original Study 5 reports p=.59 and p=.69 for separate ecology-override contrasts with no effect sizes; selected desperate-ecology contrast is provisional because locator does not distinguish the two.
